dedupe_keys.name: drc infrastructures mining and fabrication openstreetmap export by osm rdc

description: This HDX dataset is a thematic extract of OpenStreetMap for the Democratic Republic of the Congo, made by the OpenStreetMap RDC community. It gathers points, lines and polygons tagged as industrial facilities, mines, quarries, pipelines, power lines and stations, communication towers and piers, with variables for OSM type and geometry, OSM id, coordinates, a thematic label, the OSM major keys used, and tags such as man_made, landuse, power, industrial, product, substance, name, operator, operator type, address and building attributes. It is offered as zipped GeoJSON (about 258 KB) and CSV (about 226 KB) under the Open Database License, with the data dated 2 January 2020. The provider marks it as work in progress, to be revised with more detailed facility groups and water facilities, and no update schedule is set. Caveats: OSM coverage in the DRC is uneven and the extract is from 2020. For simulation it gives a quick national layer of mining, industrial and utility features that can seed exposure and network models where official data are missing. Related catalogue records include the HOT OpenStreetMap country exports on HDX and the IPIS artisanal mining sites data.
